summary: DRDGOLD Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing the results of its annual general meeting held 6 November 2026, equivalent to a US annual meeting voting report. All ordinary and special resolutions set out in the 30 September 2026 notice passed by the requisite majority, including auditor appointment (BDO South Africa), director re-elections, audit and social/ethics committee elections, and advisory approvals of the remuneration policy and implementation report. A special resolution granting a general authority to repurchase issued securities passed with 87.46% support. Roughly 89.4% of shares voted; no transaction, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is stated. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
